How to reverse a string in Go?

140

How can we reverse a simple string in Go? I tried this & it fails:

s := "hello"
for i := len(s) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
    fmt.Print(s[i])
}

2 Answers

95

In Go1 rune is a builtin type. Convert the string to runes so that multi-byte characters stay whole:

func reverse(s string) string {
    runes := []rune(s)
    for i, j := 0, len(runes)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
        runes[i], runes[j] = runes[j], runes[i]
    }
    return string(runes)
}

Use it as reverse("hola").

30

A complete program that also works with combining characters:

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

func Reverse(s string) (result string) {
	for _, v := range s {
		result = string(v) + result
	}
	return
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(strings.ToUpper(Reverse("hello, 世界")))
}
